data.name: Spaceship Trucker
data.detailed_description:
Riot in space... The committee of intergalactic travel decided to build a new star route, Star Route 66. At first the kingdom of Flee was happy to get connected to the gigantic network connecting the whole galaxy. The small empire would grow strong again and nobody can refuse the wealth that usually comes with a star route connection. After completion and a few accidents it turned out that flying one of the smaller Flee space discs on an intergalactic travel route is a dangerous game. Because of their small size the discs cannot be detected by the sensors of most star route travellers. The Flee uprising started when a member of the Fleeish royal house crashed into a spaceship truck. Since then Flees have tried to block the route. Encouraged by the royal house some of the space pirates joined in to fight the brave spaceship truckers just trying to make a delivery on time.

Spaceship Trucker is a 2D shooter. You are a spaceship trucker travelling down the dangerous star route. The Flees will try to block your way through space and pirates want to steal your precious cargo. Watch out for meteors as well. In each level you'll have to prove yourself worthy of being a spaceship trucker by fighting off dangerous boss enemies.
Good luck to you, brave spaceship trucker.

Features:
- different levels
- alien formations
- various boss fights
- highscores list
- unlockable weapon systems
- achievements

reviews.review:
Developed and published by Dreamy Doe, Spaceship Trucker is an indie side-scrolling shooter that blends classic arcade gameplay with a playful science fiction premise. Instead of portraying players as elite military pilots, the game places them behind the controls of a hardworking cargo ship captain whose job is to deliver freight across the dangerous Star Route 66. What begins as a routine transport mission quickly turns into a fight for survival after tensions erupt between humanity, the tiny Flee species, and bands of space pirates. While the narrative is intentionally simple, it adds enough personality to distinguish the game from more conventional shoot 'em ups, giving players a reason to keep pushing deeper into hostile territory.

At its core, Spaceship Trucker focuses on the timeless appeal of fast-paced arcade action. The gameplay emphasizes responsive controls, precise movement, and the ability to react quickly to increasingly complex enemy formations. Every stage introduces fresh hazards, from hostile spacecraft to asteroid fields, requiring players to constantly adjust their positioning while maintaining offensive pressure. The straightforward mechanics make the game easy to pick up, but mastering each level demands patience and practice. As enemy attacks become more aggressive, the challenge shifts from simply surviving to learning patterns and executing clean runs with minimal mistakes.

Progression throughout the campaign is supported by a selection of unlockable weapons and a variety of memorable boss encounters. Each new weapon gives players additional tactical flexibility, allowing them to experiment with different approaches to combat instead of relying on a single attack style. The boss fights stand out as some of the most enjoyable moments, featuring larger enemies with recognizable attack routines that reward observation and careful timing. Steam achievements and online leaderboards also provide added replay value, encouraging competitive players to revisit completed stages in search of higher scores and more efficient performances long after the main journey has ended.

The presentation successfully captures the spirit of retro arcade shooters through colorful pixel-inspired visuals and clean environmental design. Enemy ships, projectiles, and obstacles remain easy to identify even during the busiest firefights, which is essential for a game built around quick reflexes. The backgrounds create a convincing sense of traveling through distant sectors of space without overwhelming the action in the foreground. The soundtrack and sound effects complement the gameplay with energetic audio that reinforces the fast pace, helping maintain excitement during lengthy combat sequences even if the music itself is not especially memorable.

Although Spaceship Trucker delivers satisfying arcade gameplay, it is also a relatively compact experience. Players looking for an extensive campaign, deep storytelling, or elaborate progression systems may exhaust its content fairly quickly. Much of its longevity comes from replaying stages, improving personal scores, unlocking every achievement, and mastering each encounter rather than discovering new mechanics. Fortunately, the polished controls, steadily increasing difficulty, and enjoyable gameplay loop help prevent repetition from becoming a major issue for fans of classic arcade shooters.

Spaceship Trucker understands its audience and stays committed to delivering a focused retro-inspired experience rather than chasing unnecessary complexity. Its creative concept of combining space travel with long-haul trucking gives the game a distinctive identity, while the responsive shooting mechanics, satisfying boss battles, and replay-oriented structure provide plenty of entertainment for genre enthusiasts. Although its limited scope keeps it from reaching the heights of larger shoot 'em up releases, it succeeds as an enjoyable independent title that offers accessible yet challenging action. Players who appreciate classic arcade design and score-chasing gameplay will likely find it to be a rewarding experience. 

Rating: 6/10
